summary: Tested AI Prospecting module end-to-end (backend + UI). Backend: 24/24 pytest pass (overview, prospects list with all filters/sorts/pagination, detail/404, caller 403 on all 7 prospecting endpoints, unauth 401, invalid phase 400, cron 401 no/wrong token, cron 200 queued + X-Webhook-Id duplicate, lock prevents a second worker, prospect<->lead 1:1 linkage, leads prospect_category/prospect_segment/min_stores filters + sort=store_count asc/desc). DB check: 660 prospects = 660 'AI Prospecting' leads, 0 prospects without lead_id, 0 duplicate brand keys (unique index present). Deep research tested on ONE brand (#340 Powerhouse Gym India): status enriching -> enriched in ~60s, ceo_name set, lead #704429 updated (contact_name/ceo_name/designation=CEO/store_count). UI: nav visible for admin, hidden for caller; engine panel, 5 stats, 33 category cards, category-card filter, segment/min-stores/has-CEO/status filters, pagination, run log, pause/resume toggle (settings restored: enabled=true, India, auto, 3, create_leads=true), detail page fields + Open lead link, lead-prospect-card + Full profile link, Leads filters/columns/sorting, Dashboard all load with no page errors. Found 1 functional UI bug (stale-response race in prospect table) and several minor issues.

minor.issue: find_one_and_update returns the PRE-update doc, so p['enrich_attempts'] is the old value (e.g. 2). If the manual research then fails, enrich() computes attempts+1>=3 and marks it 'failed' immediately despite the reset to 0. Use return_document=ReturnDocument.AFTER or set p['enrich_attempts']=0 before spawning.

At batch start update_many({'status':'enriching'} -> 'discovered') also resets a manual 'Deep research now' that is still in flight (e.g. cron fires at :00 while user research runs). A lane can then pick the same brand and enrich it twice. Track enrich_started_at and only reset stale ones (> ~5 min).

Any backend reload/restart cancels the in-flight batch (observed: creating a file under /app/backend/tests triggered WatchFiles reload, batch ended after ~5 min with last_finished set). Engine only resumes at next cron tick (<=15 min). Acceptable, but consider kicking a batch on startup if enabled and the lock is free.

asyncio.gather without return_exceptions: if one lane raises (e.g. DuplicateKeyError on concurrent upsert of the same brand into two categories, or a Mongo timeout), the finally block releases the lock while the other lanes keep running → next cron can start an overlapping batch. Wrap each _lane body in try/except or use return_exceptions=True.
next_id('prospect') is evaluated for every returned brand even when the upsert matches an existing doc → id counter gaps (660 docs, max id 715). Cosmetic.

Idempotency is find_one + insert_one with no unique index on cron_runs.run_id → two simultaneous retries with the same X-Webhook-Id can both be queued (worker lock still prevents double batch, so low impact).
has_ceo=false is ignored (only true filters). Minor.

Deep research on 'Powerhouse Gym India' replaced website powerhousegym.com with hanmanfit.com and store_count 15 -> 1 (Pro model appears to have researched a different local entity). Consider not overwriting website/store_count when the new website domain differs from the discovered one, or storing both.

ui_bugs.issue: Stale-response race: every filter/keystroke fires GET /prospecting/prospects with no debounce/abort/sequence guard, so an older response can overwrite a newer one. Reproduced: change segment, min stores, clear them, then type 'lenskart' quickly → table shows '141 brands'/50 rows while search box says lenskart (single fill shows correct '1 brands'). Fix: debounce the search (300ms) and ignore out-of-order responses (request counter or AbortController).

Caller opening /prospecting directly sees 'Loading prospecting…' forever plus a 'Insufficient permissions' toast that repeats every 20s (setInterval keeps polling the 403). Route Guard uses perm='leads' instead of role admin/manager. Show an access-denied state / redirect and stop polling on 403. Same for /prospecting/:id; LeadDetail 'Full profile →' link (lead-prospect-link) is shown to callers who cannot open it.

issues: Category and Stores columns are not in DEFAULT_COLS – users must enable them via Columns menu to see/sort store counts. Consider auto-showing them when source_lead=AI Prospecting (the Prospecting page tip link).
Mode select (!w-60) truncates 'Auto — find brands first, then research' text.

action_items: Fix ProspectTable stale-response race + debounce search input
research_now: pass post-update doc (enrich_attempts=0) to enrich()
run_worker: don't reset in-flight manual 'enriching' prospects; make lanes exception-safe so the lock isn't released while lanes still run
Prospecting/ProspectDetail: handle 403 (access-denied state, stop 20s polling) and hide 'Full profile' link for callers
Optional: unique index on cron_runs.run_id; show Category/Stores columns by default for AI Prospecting leads; widen Mode select
critical_code_review_comments: prospecting.py overview imports datetime inside the function and does O(rows*agg) next() scan – fine at 33x8 but move import to top
research endpoint does not check engine enabled/lock — intended, but manual research runs outside the batch concurrency cap
has_ceo=false no-op; min_stores=0 treated as no filter (ok)
